seo.title: Accommodation | Ilala Lodge Hotel Victoria Falls
seo.description: Explore our luxurious rooms and suites at Ilala Lodge Hotel. From Classic Rooms to the exclusive Strathearn Suite, find your perfect Victoria Falls accommodation.

page_sections.hero_subheading: 73 well-appointed rooms across the Deluxe, Garden, and Pool Wings

page_sections.body:
Ilala Lodge Hotel offers 73 well-appointed rooms, designed for space, comfort, and privacy in the heart of Victoria Falls.

Rooms on the upper level open onto private balconies, while ground floor rooms lead directly onto the hotel's lush lawns, where wildlife is often seen. Elephant, warthog and hippo sightings are not uncommon, and guests may spot them feeding around the onsite waterhole.

Accommodation is available across the Deluxe Wing, Garden Wing, and Pool Wing. The Deluxe and Pool Wings offer views of the rising spray from Victoria Falls, along with the hotel's gardens. The Garden Wing provides direct access to the lawns.

All rooms feature teak furnishings, high-quality cotton linens and plush pillows to ensure a comfortable stay, complemented by attentive service throughout.

cards.title: Classic Rooms
cards.description: Twin or King beds with railway teak furnishings, opening onto the hotel's gardens and lawns where wildlife often grazes.

cards.title: Classic Suites
cards.description: Top-floor suites with private balconies overlooking the hotel grounds and the rising spray of Victoria Falls.

cards.title: Deluxe Rooms
cards.description: Set within the Deluxe Wing — refined teak accents and contemporary furnishings, with patios/balconies overlooking the gardens.

cards.title: Executive Suites
cards.description: Spacious suites in the Deluxe Wing with a separate lounge, king-size bedroom, and a private balcony facing Victoria Falls.

cards.title: Strathearn Suite
cards.description: Our most luxurious accommodation, named after founder Strathearn Brown — private lounge, kitchenette, and a heated spa bath on the balcony.

page_sections.heading: Book Your Stay Today
page_sections.body: Contact our reservations team or book directly online for the best rates.
